views.title: Component diagram for rustinfer: the library
views.intro: Each component is one crate under crates/. The bands are computed from the [dependencies] tables of each Cargo.toml on main: a crate sits one band above the highest crate it depends on, so every dependency points down.

views.title: Component diagram for rustinfer: the CLI binary
views.intro: The binary is the crate rustinfer-cli: four modules over the library. It is the only crate that names every backend, so a target is selected only through its registry (RI-TGT-004).

components.name: main
components.desc: Startup: settings from the environment, logging, the version manifest line, then dispatch.

components.name: commands
components.desc: Dispatch: build, inspect, run, tune, bench, serve. Those whose issues are open answer NotImplemented.

components.name: targets
components.desc: The architecture registry: every backend's entry, and target selection by architecture string.

components.name: cli
components.desc: Arguments, exit codes, --format json|text; results on stdout, diagnostics on stderr.

components.name: error
components.desc: One structured error per command, each carrying its component and code.
Executor, scheduler, KV cache and sampler. Today the kernel record read from an artifact.
The weight streamer: checkpoint byte ranges to device memory, with the layout transform on the way.
Topology, discovery and placement of a Model IR document on devices.
A Hugging Face checkpoint to Model IR, the weight manifest and the checkpoint identity; one Architecture per family (the seam).
The graph compiler: the pass pipeline from Model IR to a Plan under a profile.
The .rie format: header, section table, SHA-256, bounded reader, atomic writer, weight manifest.
Model IR: the typed SSA graph, shapes, dtypes and encodings, its validator and canonical JSON.
The kernel compiler: the Kernel IR dialect, its builder and the in-process MLIR/LLVM 23 link; generators and the autotuner to come.
The Target, Catalog, Device and Launcher traits, the registry entry, and the cpu module: the f32 reference every backend is checked against.
The ROCm backend for gfx942 and gfx950; a registered stub until HIP is bound behind one FFI module.
SPIR-V modules for Vulkan compute; a registered stub.
RVV 1.0 vector cores; a registered stub.
RISC-V mesh accelerators; a registered stub.
Constants, settings, structured errors, key=value logging, the version manifest.
